keeps.name: Mohican State Park Campground
keeps.waterfront_evidence: ODNR per-site Class A campground map (mohicancampmap.pdf) draws the river-side row (sites 69-86 and even 88-104, plus 146-153) directly on the Clear Fork with paddling access; Ohio OSIP leaf-off imagery with ReserveOhio per-site coordinates plotted: pad ends about 20-25 m from the water at sites 70-75, 85-86 and 153, 30-45 m along the rest of the row, with no road, parking or day-use strip between, only a thinly treed strip; ODNR site photos (70, 72, 73, 90, 98) show open grass and spaced trunks, no continuous screen. River about 30 m wide on the same frames. Canopy hides all this in leaf-on imagery, where the earlier not-waterfront call was made. The north rows and inner loops are not on the water.
keeps.inclusion_evidence: ReserveOhio facility 515 per-site details (2027-06-15): 146 web-bookable RV sites, 98 electric and 48 full hookup, every one with a posted pad length of 35-61 ft, so all 146 take 23 ft; ODNR campground page: '100 electric, 51 full hook-up, and 33 non-electric sites'. Own entrance on SR 3 (ODNR map, 'Class A Campground Entrance').
keeps.note:
Sites are out in the open, but the park is worth seeing.
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
The campground lies in the Clear Fork valley; the river-side row backs onto the river through a strip of trees, and the north rows sit along the park road at the foot of the hill. --Claude

sites.note: 146 web-bookable RV sites. Electric (98): 1-26, 65-104, 106, 108, 110-131, 146-153, pads 35-61 ft. Full hookup (48): 27-44, 46, 48-55, 57-64, 133-145, pads 38-56 ft. Pull-throughs (28): odd sites 1-37 and 39, 40, 41, 49-59 odd. The ten tent-only sites T-1 to T-10 are walk-to and not counted. ODNR counts 100 electric and 51 full-hookup sites. Up to two pets per site.

hookups.note: Water and sewer at the 48 full-hookup sites only, and those are electric only in the off season (mid-November to March 31).

facilities.note: Swimming pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day), playground, volleyball and basketball courts, nature center. Off-peak (mid-November to March 31) showerhouse 1 and pit latrine 1 stay open, and water is available at the dump station.

season.note: Off-peak (mid-November to March 31) only sites 46-64, 86-108 and 133-153 stay open.

booking.note: No driving through the campground for visitors Memorial Day to Labor Day.

fees.note: $41 a night for an electric site, $56 for full hookups, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both are $37. The ten tent-only sites are $31 in season.

adds.name: Mohican State Park Class B Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Ohio OSIP leaf-off imagery with ReserveOhio per-site coordinates plotted (40.6105,-82.3047): all 14 RV sites (B-10 to B-23) lie north of the park road, which runs between them and the Clear Fork. Pad to water about 18-24 m at B-11, B-12 and B-18 to B-20, about 30-40 m at B-13 to B-17 with a car pull-off across the road, a road being a disqualifying buffer. ODNR's own site photos looking across the road (B-13, B-14, B-19 to B-23) show trees and a grassy bank and no water, so no view is confirmed. ODNR's 'some of the non-electric sites are located along the river' is not site-level, and the tent sites B-1 to B-9 sit closest. Leaf-on imagery is canopy-blind here.
adds.inclusion_evidence: ReserveOhio facility 516 ('Mohican Campground 2') per-site details, 2027-06-15: 23 web-bookable sites, 14 with IsRVSite true (B-10 to B-23), all Back In, no pad length posted; the agency is silent on length. OSIP leaf-off imagery measures the visible gravel spurs at about 13-15 m (44-48 ft at B-17, B-18) and ODNR's site photos show gravel spurs with a timber stop, so a 23-ft rig fits. Drive-in at its own dead-end road, reached separately from the Class A campground: ODNR map routes 'Class B Campground' by SR 97 west, 'approximately five miles from the main campground'; no road links the two along the gorge (imagery).
adds.note: Primitive campground in the Clear Fork gorge, about five road miles from the main campground. RV sites are B-10 to B-23, gravel spurs along a dead-end park road with the river across it; B-1 to B-9 are tent sites. --Claude

sites.note: 14 RV sites, B-10 to B-23, all back-in, no length posted by the agency. The other nine sites (B-1 to B-9), about 550 m west, are not RV sites. Up to two pets per site.

hookups.note: 'No electric hook-ups'. No water or sewer hookup is listed on any site.

facilities.note: Pit toilets. Campers may use the Class A campground's showers and pool. No dump station is listed here; the park's is at Class A.

season.note: ODNR: 'Class B sites 1-23 are open until the first Monday after the second gun season closes in mid-December', so the closing date moves; December 21 is the last night sold in 2026. ReserveOhio opens the area April 1, 2027.

booking.note: On ReserveOhio (read 2026-10-31) sites B-10 to B-23 sell through December 21, 2026, but are blocked from April 1 through April 30, 2027, the end of the booking window, while B-1 to B-9 sell; no reason is given.

fees.note: $27 a night, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026) $23.
